Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Raipur ANRF-Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Raipur ANRF-Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to apply via email for the ANRF-Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Raipur is 31 August 2026. Candidates are encouraged to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the walk-in interview date for the ANRF-Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the ANRF-Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Raipur is scheduled for 01 September 2026. Ensure you arrive at the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the ANRF-Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the ANRF-Junior Research Fellow position, candidates must have a First class M.E./M.Tech. in Chemical/ Environmental Engineering or an MSc in Chemistry or related areas from a recognized Institute/University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the ANRF-Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the ANRF-Junior Research Fellow position is 30 years. There is no mention of minimum age or age relaxation in the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the ANRF-Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The salary for the ANRF-Junior Research Fellow is Rs. 37,000/- per month + HRA if the candidate is GATE or NET qualified. If not qualified, the salary is Rs. 30,000/- per month + HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the ANRF-Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the ANRF-Junior Research Fellow recruitment at NIT Raipur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the ANRF-Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the ANRF-Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Raipur involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates should be prepared for both stages.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for NIT Raipur ANRF-Junior Research Fellow recruitment going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the NIT Raipur office. The specific address is NIT Raipur, Raipur, Chhattisgarh, 492010. Please refer to the official notification for exact venue details.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates attending the walk-in interview must carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The ANRF-Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Raipur is a contractual job. This means the employment is for a fixed term as per the project requirements.
